rows.grounds: direct object of the command to hear
compound qualifying the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
imperative command addressed to the listener
compound describing the nectar as consisting in Kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: The listener is commanded to hear the nectar.
This nectar is identified as the true essence of Kaula.
This nectar consists in the nature of Kāmakalā.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is essentially the nature of Kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal nuance of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, whose very nature is Kāmakalā.
